chunks: I said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, "What is required of a man in seeking sustenance?" So he said, "O Sadir, when you open your door and spread your mat, then you have fulfilled what is required of you."

key_terms.بَسَطْتَ بِسَاطَكَ: you spread your mat, meaning you prepared the means for earning
key_terms.فَتَحْتَ بَابَكَ: you opened your door, meaning you made yourself available for work or provision
key_terms.قَضَيْتَ مَا عَلَيْكَ: you have fulfilled what is required of you

ai.seo_question: What is required of a person in seeking sustenance according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a person is required to make a reasonable effort in seeking sustenance, and that opening oneself to lawful work is itself a fulfillment of duty. It emphasizes trust, moderation, and that provision is not dependent solely on excessive striving.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
I asked Abu Abdullah (as): "What is required of a man in seeking sustenance?"
Imam (as) replied: "O Sadir, if you open your door and spread your mat, then you have fulfilled what is required of you."
